first_page: Email desk page /mail/ for people who write mail and want help without giving up their inbox. First: compose with subject, recipients and body, writing-aids (shorten, fix tone) on the draft, templates and drafts kept on the device, send through the person's own mail app (mailto) or copy; open a pasted or dropped .eml to see sender, real link targets and attachments with a phishing check. Will not build: a mailbox, SMTP sending, accounts or spam filtering.
